ui.aboutLead: The world is my school; nature and human life are my textbooks.
ui.bio1: Hello! I'm RANHI (岚曦), based in Tokyo. I mainly draw Vocaloid and anime characters, especially Hatsune Miku. Japanese digital illustration from the 2010s has been a major influence on my work, and I've always loved its fresh colours and sense of clarity.
ui.bio2: I want to develop my own way of drawing Miku and express my feelings through art. If a picture I share online reaches someone, somewhere in the world, and moves them, that alone makes me happy.
ui.storyIntro: In 2016, not long after becoming a Hatsune Miku fan, I discovered the work of Kyod+, now known as あさひクロイ and often called 旭酱 by Chinese fans. The artist's Miku illustrations were adorable and full of life, with beautifully clear colours. Many still stop me in my tracks today. That was when I picked up a pencil and began making studies of those drawings.
ui.milestone2016Title: It started with a drawing I loved
ui.milestone2021Body: I bought a drawing tablet and began learning Photoshop. During university, I gradually moved from studies to composing my own pictures. I also displayed my work at Wuhan University's anime club booth and made promotional flyers.
ui.milestone2024Body: After graduating and starting work, I made time to draw a MAGICAL MIRAI 2024 illustration. It was later featured by the official Hatsune Miku / piapro account. I was thrilled—it was the first time I really felt my work was reaching further out into the world.
ui.milestone2025Body: I moved to Tokyo on my own to live and work, hoping to attend more Miku and anime events. The creative atmosphere, city streets, and natural scenery around me offered plenty of inspiration, but my job still left little time or energy for drawing.
ui.milestone2026Body: In April, I left my job to focus on practice and study drawing more systematically. I made more pieces in the next six months than in the previous four years combined, and could finally see a real difference in my work.
ui.storyClosingTitle: The artist who inspired me saw my work
ui.storyClosingBody: Recently, あさひクロイ followed me on Pixiv. Going from picking up a pencil because of this artist's work to having my own drawings seen in return was one of the most memorable moments of my creative life. I still love the style that first moved me, and I want to carry that love forward as I slowly tell stories of my own.

artworkNotes.winter-midnight: My entry for the SAPPORO❅雪ミクWAON 2027 card illustration competition on piapro. Snow Miku lies on the water on a snowy night in Sapporo. Stars reflect on the surface, while the Sapporo TV Tower and distant buildings shimmer faintly in the background.
artworkNotes.moonlight-and-osmanthus: Drawn for the 2026 Mid-Autumn Festival. Miku looks back with a smile beside a lake, her face half hidden behind a round fan. Lights line the far shore and sky lanterns dot the night sky, while petals drift from the osmanthus branches beside her.
artworkNotes.miku-with-you: Miku floats in the air in her MIKU WITH YOU 2026 outfit, with a train stretching into the distance behind her. The conductor, 竹音, stands on the train holding balloons, as if waving toward the viewer. Ribbons and balloons drift in the breeze, while a distant Ferris wheel and hot-air balloons fill out the sunny carnival scene. I wanted to capture the bustle and excitement of a festival.
artworkNotes.magical-mirai: Miku sits on a sandy lakeshore in her MAGICAL MIRAI 2026 outfit, with sunflowers nearby and gentle ripples on the lake. I used soft colours to capture a quiet moment in summer.
artworkNotes.station-no-19: Drawn for Hatsune Miku's 19th anniversary. I imagined her journey as a railway line, with 2026 marking its nineteenth stop. The station sign leads from Memory, through Hatsune Miku, to Future—a look back at the past and ahead to what comes next.
artworkNotes.gets-sucked-in: My entry for the Nissin Yakisoba U.F.O. 50th-anniversary collaboration contest. Miku is lifted off the ground toward a bowl-shaped UFO, with noodles flying everywhere. I wanted to capture her surprise and the rush of being pulled into the air.
artworkNotes.hikari: My entry for the 星之翼 illustration contest on Pixiv. Hikari, wearing a school-style swimsuit, splashes in the sea with her friends. I used bright colours and lively movement to capture the feeling of summer.
artworkNotes.the-new-mirai: An illustration celebrating the release of Hatsune Miku's Vocaloid 6 voicebank. I tried a bold overhead angle and strong perspective to express the energy and confidence of this new Miku—a new ‘mirai’, or future.
artworkNotes.above-the-clouds: Miku stands in a white dress on a viewing deck above the clouds. I wanted the open sky, clear colours, and movement of the breeze to give the scene a calm, airy feeling.
artworkNotes.flower-terms: Inspired by Vocaloid producer scop's song Yubikiri, with an outfit based on the Hanakotoba (花詞) module from Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA. The setting draws on the rain-soaked railway crossing in the game's music video and the flowers on the song's album artwork.
artworkNotes.character-art: My entry for a POPPRO illustration contest: full-body drawings of Hatsune Miku, Kagamine Rin, Megurine Luka, and MEIKO in their official PIAPRO CHARACTERS outfits. This was my first time drawing a set of full-body character illustrations, and it took a lot of work.
artworkNotes.place-for-two: A young Sylphiette from Mushoku Tensei gazes at the wand Rudeus gave her in the shade of a tree. Through soft light and her look of admiration, I wanted to revisit a warm moment from their childhood together.
artworkNotes.first-step: Roxy from Mushoku Tensei looks toward the morning sun after saying goodbye to the young Rudeus and his family. She helped him take his first step outside the house. I wanted to capture her reluctance to leave the family, alongside her hopes for how both she and Rudeus would grow.
artworkNotes.miku-and-teto: Drawn for a university club event. Miku, in her NT outfit, and Teto, in her SV outfit, press their cheeks together and make heart signs with their hands. I wanted their gestures and interaction to show the closeness between the two virtual singers.
